parameters.name: Device
parameters.description: The list of devices to add to the group.

sub_parameters.name: DeviceName
sub_parameters.description: The name of the device to add to the group. You can specify up to 200 device names.

sub_parameters.name: ProductKey
sub_parameters.description: The ProductKey of the product to which the device to add to the group belongs. You can specify up to 200 ProductKeys.

parameters.name: GroupId
parameters.description: The group ID, which is the globally unique identifier of the group.

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID. On the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console, view the **ID** of the current instance.

><notice>
- If an ID value is available, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If no <props="intl"><ph>**Overview** page or </ph></props>ID value is available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Overview](~~356505~~).
